articles.title: Bengaluru: Class-1 Student Allegedly Forced to Stand in Sun for 2 Hours for Being 2 Minutes Late
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Allegations of harsh punishment have surfaced against the principal of Chaitanya School after a first-standard student was reportedly made to stand in the sun for nearly two hours for arriving just two minutes late to school.

body.html:
Allegations of harsh punishment have surfaced against the principal of Chaitanya School after a first-standard student was reportedly made to stand in the sun for nearly two hours for arriving just two minutes late to school.

According to the complaint, the incident took place near Attur Layout Daba Cross in Bengaluru.

The child’s parents alleged that the principal punished the young student by forcing the child to remain standing outside in the heat for an extended period. They claim the punishment lasted close to two hours despite the minor delay in arrival.

When the parents later approached the school to question the incident, they alleged that the principal behaved arrogantly and dismissed their concerns rather than addressing the issue.

The incident has sparked anger among parents and local residents, with many demanding strict action against the school administration and a proper inquiry into the alleged misconduct.

So far, authorities have not issued any official statement regarding the allegations, and it remains unclear whether a formal investigation has been initiated.

articles.title: Bihar Shock: ‘Quack Doctor’ Uses Office Stapler on Youth’s Head Instead of Stitches
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of alleged medical negligence has surfaced from Nawada, where a man claiming to be a doctor reportedly treated a head injury by inserting stapler pins into a young man’s scalp instead of stitching the wound.

body.html:
A shocking case of alleged medical negligence has surfaced from Nawada, where a man claiming to be a doctor reportedly treated a head injury by inserting stapler pins into a young man’s scalp instead of stitching the wound. A video of the incident is now widely circulating on social media.

According to reports, the incident took place in Naro Murar village under the jurisdiction of Warisaliganj Police Station. The injured youth had reportedly suffered a serious head injury and skull fracture on March 3.

Seeking treatment, he went to a practitioner in Ganesh Nagar. However, the victim alleged that instead of providing proper medical treatment or stitching the wound, the practitioner used a standard office stapler to insert pins into his head.

The unusual and disturbing treatment reportedly stunned those present. Someone at the scene recorded the procedure, and the video has since gone viral online. However, the authenticity of the viral video has not yet been independently verified.

The incident has triggered strong reactions from local residents and social media users, many of whom have called it gross negligence and demanded strict action against unqualified medical practitioners.

Local residents have also urged the health department to crack down on such alleged “quack doctors,” saying such practices put lives at risk.

So far, neither the local administration nor the alleged doctor has issued an official statement regarding the incident. Authorities are yet to confirm whether an investigation has been launched into the matter.

#Bihar #Nawada #MedicalNegligence #QuackDoctor #ViralVideo #HealthCare #IndiaNews #BreakingNews

articles.title: Widow Beaten by In-Laws in Auraiya: Viral Video Shows Assault After Husband’s Death
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing incident has surfaced from Auraiya, where a woman and her sister were allegedly assaulted by her in-laws. A video of the incident is circulating on social media, prompting police to launch an investigation.

body.html:
A disturbing incident has surfaced from Auraiya, where a woman and her sister were allegedly assaulted by her in-laws. A video of the incident is circulating on social media, prompting police to launch an investigation.

The victim, Akanksha Tiwari, was married to Shivkumar Tiwari on May 3, 2023. The couple has a 16-month-old daughter named Shreya. However, Shivkumar passed away on August 28, 2025, after which Akanksha alleges that harassment from her in-laws intensified.

According to her complaint, her father-in-law Mahendra Babu Tiwari and sisters-in-law Soni Tiwari and Ruchi Tiwari repeatedly pressured her to leave the house. She claims they abused, threatened, and assaulted her on several occasions after her husband’s death.

Akanksha said she had earlier contacted the police helpline and authorities intervened to settle the dispute. However, tensions reportedly continued.

About a month ago, Akanksha informed her parents about the ongoing harassment. Her father Manoj Kumar and younger sister Pratiksha came to Auraiya, and Pratiksha had been staying with her since then.

The latest incident reportedly occurred around noon on March 8, 2026. Akanksha alleged that her father-in-law abused both sisters and ordered them to leave the house. When she objected, Mahendra Babu Tiwari and the two sisters-in-law allegedly assaulted her inside the house.

She further claimed that Soni and Ruchi dragged her outside while abusing her and continued beating her, causing internal injuries.

During the assault, Pratiksha recorded part of the incident on her mobile phone. The video has now been submitted to the police as evidence.

Police in Auraiya said they have taken cognisance of the viral video and initiated an investigation. Officials added that appropriate legal action will be taken against the accused if the allegations are confirmed.

#Auraiya #UttarPradesh #DomesticViolence #ViralVideo #WomenSafety #IndiaNews #BreakingNews #PoliceInvestigation

articles.title: Bribe Caught on Camera: UP Health Dept Clerk Seen Taking ₹45,000 Despite Court Order
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video showing a government clerk allegedly accepting a bribe of ₹45,000 from a retired employee has triggered outrage in Basti, raising questions over the Uttar Pradesh government’s claims of zero tolerance towards corruption.

body.html:
A video showing a government clerk allegedly accepting a bribe of ₹45,000 from a retired employee has triggered outrage in Basti, raising questions over the Uttar Pradesh government’s claims of zero tolerance towards corruption.

The incident reportedly took place at the Vikramjot Community Health Center, where senior clerk Pradeep Srivastava was caught on camera allegedly taking money from retired employee Sunita Verma in exchange for clearing her pending arrears.

According to reports, Sunita Verma had been waiting for a long time to receive her dues from the department. After the delay continued, the matter reached court, which reportedly ordered the department to release the payment within four weeks.

However, the clerk allegedly demanded a “facilitation fee” to move the file forward, claiming that the court order would remain stuck unless money was paid.

Frustrated by the repeated demands, the victim and her family decided to expose the alleged corruption. While the clerk was accepting the money, Verma’s brother secretly recorded the incident on his mobile phone.

The viral video reportedly shows the clerk calmly counting the cash, sparking anger among local health workers and the public.

Reacting to the controversy, Rajiv Kumar Nigam said the department has taken cognisance of the viral video.

He stated that the authenticity of the video is being verified and, if the allegations are found true, strict departmental and legal action will be taken against the employee involved.

The incident has stirred debate in the district about corruption within government offices, especially when the alleged bribe demand came despite a court order directing payment to the retired employee.

articles.title: Agra Tragedy: Fashion Designer Dies, Accuses Police Constable of Exploitation in Viral Video
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 34-year-old fashion designer died by taking drastic step in Agra after recording emotional videos in which she accused a police constable of exploiting her and refusing to marry her after a long relationship.

body.html:
A 34-year-old fashion designer died by taking drastic step in Agra after recording emotional videos in which she accused a police constable of exploiting her and refusing to marry her after a long relationship.

The incident took place in the Sainik Nagar area under the Sadar Police Station limits. The woman was found hanging in her room late Wednesday night by her younger sister.

According to police, the woman was originally from Kasganj and had been living in Agra after separating from her husband several years ago. She had reportedly been in a live-in relationship for nearly four years with constable Jentar Babu alias JB Gautam, who works as a computer operator at Tajganj Police Station.

In videos that surfaced after her death and went viral on social media, the woman alleged that the constable had promised to marry her and kept her “like a wife” for years but later refused. She also claimed she had approached the police station to file a complaint, but no FIR was registered and she was allegedly told that nothing would happen to a policeman.

The woman further alleged that the constable and his family mentally and physically harassed her. In the videos, she said she had lost hope of getting justice while alive and hoped action would be taken after her death.

After the videos surfaced, police registered a case following a complaint filed by her father. The accused constable, identified as Jentar Babu alias JB Gautam, has been arrested and sent to jail.

Syed Ali Abbas said the woman had not previously submitted a written complaint at the police station. However, after the videos came to light, a case was registered for abetment to and establishing a relationship on the false promise of marriage.

Police said the woman had earlier completed a fashion design course in Lucknow and had been active on social media, where several videos with the accused constable were reportedly shared.

Her death has sparked anger and grief among family members, who are demanding strict action against the accused. Police said further investigation into the case is underway.

articles.title: Viral Street Brawl in Jhansi: Woman With Stone Attacks Youth at Elite Square After Minor Crash
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic street fight broke out at the busy Elite intersection in Jhansi, where a young woman armed with a stone allegedly attacked a man following a minor vehicle collision.

body.html:
A dramatic street fight broke out at the busy Elite intersection in Jhansi, where a young woman armed with a stone allegedly attacked a man following a minor vehicle collision. The shocking incident, which occurred in the Navabad police station area, was captured on video and has since gone viral on social media.

According to reports, the altercation began after a minor collision between two vehicles at the city’s crowded Elite Square. What started as a verbal dispute quickly escalated into a violent street brawl.

Videos circulating online show the woman holding a large stone and striking a young man while shouting aggressively. Her companions are also seen joining the attack, allegedly kicking and punching the man before throwing him to the ground.

Despite the violence unfolding in a busy public area, bystanders reportedly did not intervene and many instead recorded the incident on their mobile phones.

Police from Navabad station reached the spot after receiving information and detained around half a dozen people, including the woman involved. During the investigation, officials found that the woman and some of her companions reportedly work in an orchestra group.

According to police, the incident occurred around 3 am on March 12. Taking immediate cognisance after the video surfaced online, authorities arrested members from both sides and initiated legal action under relevant sections before producing them in court.

Police said action has been taken against around 10 individuals involved in the clash and further investigation is underway. Officials added that strict action will be taken against anyone found guilty and that law and order in the area remains normal.

#Jhansi #UttarPradesh #ViralVideo #StreetFight #EliteSquare #BreakingNews #IndiaNews #PoliceAction

articles.title: In Fatehpur: Woman, Son and Brother-in-Law Found Dead; Note Mentions Threats of ‘False SC/ST Case’
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident has emerged from Fatehpur district, where three members of a family were found dead inside their house in Chauferava village under the Kotwali police station area late on Wednesday night.

body.html:
A shocking incident has emerged from Fatehpur district, where three members of a family were found dead inside their house in Chauferava village under the Kotwali police station area late on Wednesday night.

The deceased were identified as Sushila Srivastava (55), her son Amar Srivastava (28), and her brother-in-law Sunil Kumar Srivastava (around 54).

According to police, the bodies were discovered inside the house with several cut marks on the neck and hands. Investigators also recovered multiple empty **** pouches and four blood-stained blades from the scene, indicating a violent end.

During the investigation, police reportedly recovered a death note believed to have been written by Amar Srivastava. The note claimed that the family had been facing threats of being falsely implicated under the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act in connection with a financial dispute.

The note alleged that mounting pressure and intimidation from certain individuals pushed the family to take the extreme step.

Police and forensic teams immediately reached the spot, cordoned off the house and collected evidence. Officials said the claims mentioned in the note are being verified as part of the investigation.

According to reports, Sushila’s husband, Sushil Kumar Srivastava, a van driver, had reportedly returned home and discovered the bodies inside a locked room.

Villagers expressed shock over the incident, describing the family as well-known residents of Chauferava village. Authorities are now examining CCTV footage from nearby areas and questioning relatives and acquaintances to reconstruct the sequence of events.

Police said the investigation is ongoing and further action will be taken after verifying the allegations mentioned in the note.

articles.title: Allahabad HC Orders 24×7 Protection for Bareilly Man Allegedly Stopped From Offering Namaz at Home
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The Allahabad High Court has directed round-the-clock police protection for a Muslim man from Bareilly who alleged that he was prevented from offering Namaz inside his private residence.

body.html:
The Allahabad High Court has directed round-the-clock police protection for a Muslim man from Bareilly who alleged that he was prevented from offering Namaz inside his private residence.

A division bench comprising Justice Atul Sreedharan and Justice Siddharth Nandan ordered that two armed guards be deployed to provide 24/7 security to Haseen Khan.

The court further stated that if any act of violence occurs against Khan or his property, it would be prima facie presumed to have occurred at the instance of the State.

According to the petition, Khan had earlier approached authorities seeking permission to conduct a religious congregation to offer Namaz at his home. During earlier proceedings, the state government informed the court that no permission is required for an individual to perform Namaz in a private residence, as it falls under the fundamental right to freedom of religion guaranteed by Article 25 of the Constitution of India.

However, it was later alleged that Khan was picked up by police from his home while offering Namaz, challaned, threatened with demolition, and allegedly forced to sign blank papers.

Following these allegations, a contempt petition was filed against state authorities.

During the hearing, the Additional Advocate General representing the state informed the court that permission had actually been sought from people present in the house before offering Namaz.

Taking note of the circumstances, the court ordered security protection for Khan and directed that the guards should accompany him wherever he goes.

The court has also summoned the District Magistrate and Senior Superintendent of Police of Bareilly to appear before it on March 23 in connection with the matter.

The case is titled Tarik Khan vs State of Uttar Pradesh.

#AllahabadHighCourt #Bareilly #UttarPradesh #Namaz #ReligiousFreedom #Article25 #IndiaNews #CourtOrder

articles.title: Blinkit Delivery Row Turns Violent in Bengaluru: Customer’s Nose Fractured After Late-Night Argument
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A late-night argument between a customer and a delivery executive in Bengaluru reportedly turned violent, leaving the customer with a fractured nose. The incident occurred around 2 am on March 7 at an apartment complex in Koramangala. According to police, the victim, Paul J.

body.html:
A late-night argument between a customer and a delivery executive in Bengaluru reportedly turned violent, leaving the customer with a fractured nose. The incident occurred around 2 am on March 7 at an apartment complex in Koramangala.

According to police, the victim, Paul J. Vithayathil, had placed an order through the quick-commerce platform Blinkit and was waiting at his flat for the delivery.

Investigators said the delivery executive allegedly went to the wrong location inside the building while trying to complete the order. When Paul contacted him and asked him to come to the correct floor, an argument reportedly broke out.

Police identified the accused as Tanush, a delivery worker from Ejipura. Authorities said he later reached the customer’s residence, where the dispute escalated.

During the confrontation, the delivery executive allegedly punched the customer in the face, threw the ordered items and fled the spot.

The injured customer sought medical treatment, where doctors conducted examinations including an X-ray of the nasal bones. The reports confirmed a fracture in his nose.

Due to the severity of the injury, Paul later travelled to Kerala to undergo surgery.

Based on the complaint and medical findings, police first registered a Non-Cognizable Report (NCR) and later converted it into an FIR. The accused delivery executive was subsequently tracked down and arrested.

Police have contacted Blinkit for details related to the delivery worker, and further investigation into the circumstances leading to the altercation is underway.
